title: Launchpad initiative: centralized tracking for SDKs, docs, and quickstart programs
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a single, repeatable initiative tracking model for all Developer Experience (DevX) programs focused on SDKs, documentation, and quickstarts. The Launchpad initiative bundles a templated roadmap, a cycle-level cadence, and a lightweight OKR/metric set so PMs, Eng, and Design can run multiple kit launches consistently.

Scope: 1) Standardize milestone definitions (alpha quickstart, public docs, sample apps, GA SDK). 2) Ship a tracking dashboard and checklist used in each cycle. 3) Run two pilot kit launches (Python SDK v2 + JS quickstarts) and iterate. 4) Create playbook and templates for future teams.

Why now: Fragmented tracking across repos and teams has caused delayed SDK releases and uneven quickstart quality. This initiative reduces friction for early adopters and shortens time-to-first-call, helping downstream adoption and usage metrics.
updates: 2025-01-14: Kickoff with Eng, Design, and Docs. Agreed milestones and initial metric set.
2025-01-22: Draft tracking dashboard wireframe created; linking to prototype in docs_links.
2025-01-30: Pilot scope narrowed to Python SDK v2 and JS quickstart templates. ENG-3091 assigned for telemetry hooks.
2025-02-05: Cross-functional review: design gave accessibility feedback; PM approved change to milestone definitions. Next: implement telemetry events and dashboard queries.
acceptance_criteria: A templated initiative checklist exists and is used by at least two teams during the pilot cycle
Dashboard surface shows per-kit: installs, first-call latency, quickstart completion rate, and sample-app errors
Two pilot kits reach beta with public docs and example repos published
Playbook and template merged into the DevX handbook with clear owner handoff guidance
metrics: Time-to-first-call target: <10 minutes for a fresh dev following quickstart
SDK adoption: increase active SDK tokens by 20% within 8 weeks of GA
Quickstart completion: 40% completion rate for guided quickstarts in first 30 days
Regression rate: sample-app CI flaky tests <1% per build
risks: Telemetry gaps across SDKs could delay dashboard readiness — mitigation: minimal event contract (ENG-3012)
Design bandwidth constrained — mitigation: reuse existing UI components and limit scope to templates
External breaking changes from infra runtime could force SDK changes — mitigation: pin runtime-compat tests in CI
next_steps: ENG: Implement event contract for quickstart completion by 2025-02-14 (ENG-3012)
DOCS: Publish quickstart template draft and acceptance tests by 2025-02-21
DESIGN: Finalize dashboard layout and sample-app UX by 2025-02-18
PM: Run weekly triage every Tuesday and a cross-functional milestone review on 2025-02-28
